scheme_name: Wire Fencing Around the Farm for Crop Protection
other_conditions: Applicant must be a land‑holding farmer or a farmer group
Applicant must have a minimum of 2 hectares of land in a cluster
Only one of the holders mentioned in 8‑A land records per account is eligible, with consent of other holders
A farmer is eligible for assistance for a maximum of one account
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹200 per running meter (or 50% of actual expenditure, whichever is less) for wire fencing, available once in a lifetime.
